title: Volcanoes of Colombia
intro: 10 volcanoes of Colombia, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Huila, Nevado del
rounds.fact: Huila, Nevado del is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 2008. The data places it in Colombia.
